newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's recovery to focus on five sectors - Concha.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's recovery to focus on five sectors - Concha.

text.p: Ecuador's Finance Minister Pablo Concha said on Monday that the administration of new President Abdala Bucaram will focus on the recovery of five sectors in its economic program.
"Five sectors will be given preference in the economic program which are construction, agriculture, mining, tourism and small businesses," Concha said at a press conference.
"These sectors will be given top priority in the process of economic recovery."
He said the economic outlook for Ecuador is optimistic following the recent economic crisis.

"If we did not have the capacity and confidence in finding the solutions, the country would be at the doors of disaster and we cannot let that happen. We have to view the future with optimism," he added.
On Sunday, Concha accused the previous administration of papering over the poor state of the economy.

"The previous government concealed the figures. They did it strategically to tell the country they were handling matters well and they have brought us a sick country in a state of emergency," Concha said.
Monetary authorites have indicated the budget will be balanced by December.
